agent_notes.ingrid: Completed visual design direction and homepage wireframe (2026-03-30). Deliverable: output/2026-03-30-design-direction.md. Covers color palette (dark/light), typography (Inter + JetBrains Mono), 8px spacing system, component styles, and ASCII wireframe for all homepage sections. Accent color placeholder is #7C6FFF (violet) — pending Jorunn confirmation. Left open questions for Jorunn (brand name, tagline, voice, accent color, logo format) and implementation notes for Arve (Tailwind, dark mode strategy, Framer Motion, Lucide icons).
agent_notes.bjorn: Completed tech stack selection (2026-03-30). Deliverable: output/2026-03-30-tech-stack.md. Decision: Next.js 15 App Router with output: 'export' (fully static), Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Lucide React, next-themes for dark mode, fontsource for self-hosted fonts, deploy to Vercel free tier. No decisions are hard to reverse at this stage. Arve should use placeholder images and text wordmark until Jorunn delivers brand assets. Accent color (#7C6FFF) wired as CSS variable for single-line swap pending Jorunn confirmation.
agent_notes.else: Completed market & competitor research (2026-03-30). Deliverable: output/2026-03-30-market-research.md. Researched 8 direct competitors with live landing page data: Notion AI, Otter.ai, Reclaim.ai, Motion, Superhuman, Mem.ai, Reflect, Granola. Key finding: meeting notes and 'save X hours/week' claims are saturated. Positioning gaps for Neutral: calm/anti-hustle tone, privacy-first, single-professional premium tier, augmentation vs. full-automation framing. Recommend Jorunn read the gaps section before writing brand copy.
agent_notes.jorunn: Completed brand identity and homepage copy (2026-03-30). Deliverable: output/2026-03-30-brand-copy.md. Key decisions: tagline 'Think clearly. Work calmly.', accent color #7C6FFF confirmed, wordmark-only logo (Inter 600), voice: confident/direct/warm with no hype. Full homepage copy written for all sections: hero, 6-feature grid, 3 deep feature highlights, 3 testimonial placeholders, 3-tier pricing (Free/$0, Pro/$12mo annual, Team/$29/seat), final CTA, and footer. Arve should use copy verbatim — placeholders are marked. Brand decisions summary table in deliverable for all agents.
agent_notes.arve: Completed landing page implementation (2026-03-30). Deliverables: output/landing-page/ (complete Next.js 15 codebase) and output/2026-03-30-implementation-notes.md. All sections implemented: Navbar, Hero, Features (6-card grid), FeatureHighlight (3 alternating), Testimonials, Pricing (with annual/monthly toggle), CTA, Footer. Design tokens wired as CSS variables. Dark mode via next-themes. Framer Motion scroll animations throughout. Remaining work before launch: product screenshots, real testimonials, CTA href targets, favicon, OG image, Vercel deployment setup.
agent_notes.knut: Completed launch milestone tracker (2026-04-01). Deliverable: output/2026-04-01-launch-milestones.md. Defined 4 phases: Research & Foundation (W1), Legal & Pricing (W1-W2), GTM Preparation (W2-W3), Launch (W4, target Apr 22). Critical path: Else's competitive analysis must ship by Apr 7 — Nora (pricing) and Halvard (growth strategy) are both blocked on it. Magnus (privacy policy) has no upstream dependencies and should start immediately. Risk register has 7 items; R2 (Magnus delay) and R6 (no analytics before launch) rated Critical/High. Post-launch retro scheduled Apr 28.
agent_notes.magnus: Completed privacy policy and GDPR/CCPA compliance work (2026-04-01). Deliverables: output/2026-04-01-privacy-policy.md and output/2026-04-01-compliance-checklist.md. Key decisions: (1) AI Office is controller for account data, processor for Customer Content; (2) Customer Content must NOT be used to train AI models without explicit written consent; (3) standard DPA must be published before accepting EEA customers; (4) DPIA required for AI agent processing before EEA launch; (5) 20 engineering launch blockers identified (consent flows, DSR API, audit logs, encryption, sub-processor DPAs). Both documents require qualified legal counsel review before publication.
agent_notes.nora: Completed B2B SaaS pricing model (2026-04-01). Deliverable: output/2026-04-01-pricing-model.md. Three tiers confirmed: Free ($0, 50 AI runs/mo, 500 notes), Pro ($12/mo annual, 1,000 runs/mo, unlimited notes, E2E encryption, 14-day trial no credit card), Team ($24/seat/mo annual, 5,000 runs/seat, SSO, admin controls, sales-assisted close). Modeled two scenarios: flat subscription (Scenario A, recommended at launch) and usage-based with monthly cap (Scenario B, recommended post-50 customers). Unit economics: Pro gross margin 85%, LTV:CAC 1.73x (target 3x within 12 months), payback 10.4 months. Team gross margin 91%, LTV:CAC 3.28x, payback 7.3 months. Revenue projections: $28K ARR at 100 customers, $174K at 500, $413K at 1,000. Key decisions: no credit card for Pro trial, Team tier minimum 3 seats sales-assisted only, do not raise Pro annual price before 200 paying customers.
agent_notes.halvard: Completed growth strategy for first 100 customers (2026-04-01). Deliverable: output/2026-04-01-growth-strategy.md. ICP defined: overwhelmed knowledge workers at SMBs (10-200 employees) in professional services, research, product-led startups. Design partner target: 10 confirmed by week 6 before Product Hunt launch. Three acquisition channels: (1) developer/knowledge worker communities — HN Show HN, Reddit PKM/productivity, Product Hunt, Indie Hackers; (2) warm outbound via LinkedIn/Twitter/personal network (sales-led, reply rate target >15%); (3) SEO content targeting bottom-of-funnel comparison and problem-framing queries. Full onboarding funnel defined: signup to first note target <48h, 10-note free tier gate, no credit card required, no urgency tactics. Retention levers months 1-3 documented. 90-day week-by-week action plan with specific metrics per milestone. Note: Jorunn's brand copy has Team at $29/seat, Nora's pricing model has Team at $24/seat — this discrepancy should be resolved before the landing page is updated.

kickoff_description:
We are launching AI Office as a B2B SaaS product. We need a competitive     
  analysis of similar AI agent platforms, a pricing model for business 
  customers, a privacy policy, and a growth strategy for getting the first 100  
  customers.

kickoff_plan.title: Competitive Analysis of AI Agent Platforms
